title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
abstract: arXiv:2610.00451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. translated_title: PACT：从视频中端到端学习人体姿态、接触与作用力
translated_abstract: 人体运动、环境接触以及交互作用力都遵循共同的物理定律，然而现有方法通常将视觉姿态重建与接触及作用力估计分离开来处理。这种分离限制了对二者的联合推理，并可能在各阶段之间传播误差。我们提出了 PACT，这是一种端到端模型，能够从单目视频中联合学习估计人体姿态、接触以及接触力。我们的方法在人体重建基础模型的基础上，引入了可学习的接触力标记和一种将视觉特征与世界空间运动相融合的时间 Transformer。联合预测头用于细化人体姿态并估计接触和作用力，同时基于物理的监督机制促使重建的运动与交互作用力之间保持一致性。为了解决作用力标注数据稀缺的问题，我们开发了一套数据标注流程，该流程将接触标注与基于物理的运动和作用力优化相结合。
tldr: PACT 提出一个端到端模型，通过可学习的接触力标记、时间 Transformer 和基于物理的监督，从单目视频中联合估计人体姿态、接触与接触力，并解决作用力标注稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: PACT is an end-to-end model that jointly estimates human pose, contacts, and contact forces from monocular video using learnable contact-force tokens, a temporal transformer, and physics-based supervision.
